title: Keyturn Trip Booking: Reserved Period Limits and Portfolio Allowances by Rate Plan
content:
Every Keyturn Trip Booking is priced under one of six rate plans, and the plan the reservation carries sets the shortest and longest period it will accept, the unit of time it is priced in, how far ahead the reserved period may begin, the nights a reservation covering a Saturday must run for, the reservations the guest may hold at once and the separation two of the guest's reservations must keep. This schedule states those figures for each plan.

| Rate plan | Shortest reservation (hours) | Longest reservation (hours) | Priced in units of (hours) | Booking horizon (calendar days) | Weekend minimum (whole nights) | Reservations held at once | Separation between two reservations (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan | 1 | 12 | 0.5 | 30 | 0 | 2 | 1 |
| Keyturn Daily Rate Plan | 24 | 168 | 24 | 90 | 0 | 3 | 2 |
| Keyturn Weekend Rate Plan | 48 | 96 | 24 | 120 | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| Keyturn Weekly Rate Plan | 168 | 720 | 24 | 180 | 2 | 3 | 4 |
| Keyturn Monthly Rate Plan | 720 | 2160 | 24 | 270 | 2 | 2 | 6 |
| Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan | 2160 | 8760 | 24 | 365 | 2 | 2 | 8 |

### Reading the schedule

The shortest and longest reservation are the bounds of the reserved duration the plan accepts, in hours. The unit of time the reservation is priced in is half an hour on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan and a whole day of 24 hours on every other plan. The booking horizon is how far ahead of the start date the plan may be booked, in calendar days. The weekend minimum is expressed in whole nights, and stands at 0 nights on the two shortest plans, which is to say the plans set no such minimum. The reservations held at once counts the reservations a guest holds in the requested, booked or in-progress states, and the separation figure is the buffer in hours that two of that guest's reservations must keep between them.

Note that the ladder of allowances is not monotonic across the plans: a guest on the Keyturn Monthly Rate Plan or the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan may hold 2 reservations at once, the same figure as the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan, while the three plans in the middle of the ladder allow 3.
